$schema_note: Public-safe section templates for Mu$e's Book. No tickers, prices, or levels here — only layout: section order, data type, caps, and the display rules settled in chat 2026-11-10. Layout changes ship as commits to this file. v2 adds the SPY third series, the Mu$e identity label, the four color rules, and the two-decimal money rule settled after v1. v3 updates the identity palette to the jewel tones settled 2026-11-10 (Mu$e gold, QQQ deep teal, SPY plum). v4 records the 2026-11-11 redesign settled in chat: Inter words / Chivo Mono numbers (plain zero), the card-vs-flat split, the one-line verdict, the ledger rebuild, the two-line refresh cluster, and the breathing-room pass.

display_rules.colors: One job per color. Identity — Mu$e gold (#b8860b light / #d4af37 dark), QQQ deep teal (#0f766e light / #14b8a6 dark), SPY plum (#7e2a68 light / #c86aa8 dark) — only on chart lines, legend swatches, and the dot beside a series label. Direction — bars and change values green up / red down. Risk — red exit/danger tick, amber paused, green safe zone on gauges. Neutral captions gray.
display_rules.comparison: Three series — Mu$e (the account, gold), QQQ (the benchmark, deep teal), SPY (S&P 500 context, via SPY, plum). QQQ stays the benchmark: gap, band color, and headline are vs QQQ only. SPY is context, in its own color, dashed on the race chart.
display_rules.distance_captions: Attached to the tick they belong to, one neutral color on every card. No arrows. Paused state is shown by pill + tick label + card border, never by caption color.
display_rules.identity_labels: The account series is labeled 'Mu$e', never 'Us'.
display_rules.label_layout: Labels get a two-line zone above the gauge track; the track sits below it so a long label can never be eaten by the bar. Gauge box 76px after the 2026-11-10 shrink (was 96px).
display_rules.labels: Price-first, phrased as decisions: 'Bought $X', 'Sell at $X', 'Sell half $X', 'Break even $X'. Never accounting nouns ('paid', 'cost basis') as labels.
display_rules.money: Every dollar amount renders with exactly two decimals ($15.50, $2,000.00) — never one decimal, never three. Shorthand like $30M / $2B is left as-is.
display_rules.options: Two gauges: a stock gauge (price vs breakeven, plus the stock re-eval line) and a contract gauge (premium now vs the -50% premium exit vs the premium-double take-profit). The contract gauge carries the option's real sell line.
display_rules.sort: At-risk positions sort by distance to the primary exit, closest first. Equity: stop. Option: premium exit.
display_rules.type_system: Words in Inter (neutral grotesque; hierarchy from weight and size). Every number in Chivo Mono with tabular alignment, via one .num class. Chivo Mono's zero is plain by default -- a clean oval with no slash and no dot -- so no slashed-zero or zero-variant settings are set anywhere. No serif anywhere.
display_rules.cards_vs_flat: A card means one discrete thing to pick up and look at: each At-risk position (paused keeps its amber border on the card), the Next event, the race chart panel, and the Templates/Data/Export editor panels. Cards get a real surface, border, rounded corners, and a soft shadow. Flat means flow, ledger, or status: the verdict hero, the Today tape line, the stat strip, the exit log, the paper footnote, the steps strip, and the Blueprint list. Flat sections use hairline rules, no fill, no shadow.
display_rules.verdict_line: The verdict reads as one left-aligned line under the account value: figure and label on the same baseline in the direction color (e.g. '+6.10 pts beating QQQ'). No detached centered caption floating under the number.
display_rules.refresh: Freshness is a quiet two-line cluster in the empty top-right space beside the 'Mu$e's Book' masthead -- no border, no surface, no shadow, two lines max in every state, 36px. Line 1: status dot + 'Updated ... ago' + compact Refresh pill, all on one line. Line 2: muted mono short timestamp (e.g. 'Tue Nov 10 - close - 4:29 PM'), truncating with ellipsis rather than wrapping. Refreshing shows a spinner + 'Updating...' in the pill; success briefly shows 'Updated - latest board'; failure shows one short plain error on line 2. The cluster never shares the account value's row, so the hero number keeps its full width.
display_rules.ledger: Ledger, not cards, for flow sections: the verdict's two redundant blocks merge into one series table (one row per series: identity dot, bar, %, and what $100 becomes); Today is a single tape line; stats and cash are one ledger line; the exit log leads with its total; the paper book is a footnote line under a dashed rule; the steps strip is one line; Export leads with file rows and puts JSON behind a View toggle; Data rows group under data-type headings. 'Too much words' stays the law. Each component was rethought from its job, not retrofitted.
display_rules.breathing_room: Cards and section shells breathe: section padding up, Preview sections 40px apart, while the dense ledger lines inside tables keep their tight rhythm.

page.height_note: Recompute from the Dev Blueprint before quoting a total: 1,976px at v1, 1,916px after the gauge shrink, before the SPY rows were added; 1,774px after the 2026-11-11 ledger rebuild, 2,020px after the breathing-room pass, 2,092px after the card pass (plus the 36px refresh cluster).
page.rule: Sections render in the order listed. Each section stops growing at its cap, so total page length is deterministic no matter how much data the generator emits.
